properties.name: INIT-PARA
properties.code:
OPEN INPUT CUST-FILE
READ CUST-FILE
EXEC SQL
        SELECT NAME INTO :WS-NAME FROM CUSTOMER
    END-EXEC
EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('SUBPROG') END-EXEC.

properties.name: STEP-A
properties.code: ALTER STEP-B TO PROCEED TO INIT-EXIT.

properties.name: STEP-B
properties.code:
WRITE CUST-REC
GOBACK.
END PROGRAM MAINPROG.

properties.name: MAIN-PARA
properties.code:
PERFORM INIT-PARA THRU INIT-EXIT
IF WS-STATUS = 0
CALL "SUBPROG" USING WS-STATUS
ELSE
CALL WS-PROGRAM
END-IF
GO TO STEP-A STEP-B DEPENDING ON WS-STATUS.

properties.name: PROCESS-PARA
properties.code:
ADD 1 TO WS-COUNT
IF WS-COUNT > 10
PERFORM SUMMARY-PARA VARYING WS-COUNT FROM 1 BY 1
UNTIL WS-COUNT > 5
ELSE
MOVE PAY-REC TO RPT-REC
END-IF.

properties.name: SUMMARY-PARA
properties.code:
COMPUTE WS-GROSS = WS-GROSS + WS-COUNT
WRITE RPT-REC.

properties.name: INIT-PARA
properties.code:
OPEN INPUT PAY-FILE
OPEN OUTPUT RPT-FILE
PERFORM UNTIL WS-EOF = "Y"
READ PAY-FILE
AT END MOVE "Y" TO WS-EOF
NOT AT END PERFORM PROCESS-PARA
END-READ
END-PERFORM.

properties.name: SELECT
properties.raw_text:
EXEC SQL
        SELECT NAME INTO :WS-NAME FROM CUSTOMER
    END-EXEC
